video_title: Wemby, Dylan Harper & Mitch Johnson reflect on Spurs dropping Game 4 to Knicks | 2026 NBA Finals

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on the Spurs' offensive struggles in Game 4
quotes.excerpt: We got away from what got us the 76 points in the first half.
quotes.quote: We got away from what got us the 76 points in the first half, just in terms of putting pressure on the rim, rolling after screens, running, continuing to find the paint, whether for ourselves or for a teammate. We got on our heels, missed some shots, and then you don't get as many free throws and high-percentage looks when you play on your heels like that.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on when the Spurs lost momentum in Game 4
quotes.excerpt: We got away from playing the brand of basketball that got us the lead.
quotes.quote: There were times where again, I felt part of that third quarter and then some part probably early mid in the fourth quarter again, where we got away from playing the brand of basketball that got us the lead. You saw the at times aggressiveness and the just conviction that we played with early on dissipate a little bit, and they made some shots and that's where you felt the momentum a little bit. We just needed a few more tough-minded plays to finish the job.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on the pain of losing a game the Spurs played well in
quotes.excerpt: That's a game where you sit there and you say you had the type of first half you had.
quotes.quote: That's a game where you sit there and you say you had the type of first half you had, and you shot the ball decent, you played a pretty clean game, and then just didn't finish the job and stopped putting the energy in the right spots that got you that lead. Now, we got to go home in two days and approach it the same way. We got one game that we got to win, and we got to be more consistent and more tough-mindedness and finish the job and finish stronger at the end.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on the controversial foul call on Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: I think he grabbed Victor or hooked him or something, but there was something there that was approximate foul.
quotes.quote: I think he grabbed Victor or hooked him or something, but there was something there that was approximate foul, and if it wasn't, it felt like Victor at least had a clean block, so that's why we challenged it.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on how the Spurs will refocus for Game 5
quotes.excerpt: Tell them to feel the emotion tonight because they're competitive.
quotes.quote: Tell them to feel the emotion tonight because they're competitive, and that's unhumanly possible to not, and tomorrow take all the emotion out. They better be ready to play in two days and win.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on the Spurs' offensive philosophy
quotes.excerpt: We need to continue to put pressure on the rim and touch the paint and crash.
quotes.quote: We need to continue to put pressure on the rim and touch the paint and crash, because you don't always make even the best three-point looks. We missed some really good shots in the second half, and so you have to continue to be tough-minded enough to play the brand of basketball regardless of the outcome or what the score is.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on the Spurs' mindset after the Game 4 loss
quotes.excerpt: We just lost about 20 minutes ago, and it hasn't really hit me, but I mean, probably shock.
quotes.quote: We just lost about 20 minutes ago, and it hasn't really hit me, but I mean, probably shock. But I mean, a whole lot more basketball to be played. I'm never going to, after this is over, go take a shower, wash it off and go get ready for Game 5. Most important game, just got to focus on the next 48 minutes.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on the Spurs' mentality heading into Game 5
quotes.excerpt: Got to realize that the most important thing is the next game.
quotes.quote: Got to realize that the most important thing is the next game. I think, you know, backs against the wall, you advance to the call every time, so I mean this is no different for us. I mean, it's not, it's not no time to complain, not no time to point fingers. It's time for us to step up and it's time for us to, if we believe, we are who we think we are, then it's going to show.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on the Spurs' response to the loss
quotes.excerpt: If we going to lose, I mean, we're not going out like that.
quotes.quote: I feel like as a group, you know, we don't really get into the mental thing, but I mean for me, I, it's going to, a whole new fire I feel like is ignited in me in a sense of just gave that game away and I, and then if we going to lose, I mean, we're not, we're not going out like that. We going to, we going to, we going to keep swinging.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on the Spurs' offensive approach in the second half
quotes.excerpt: We went away from everything we were doing.
quotes.quote: We went away from everything we were doing. I think in the first half a lot of shots went in and a lot of, a lot of tough shots went in, but really that was because we was playing the right way and I think we got away from that in second half because of the lead. But we just can't take our foot off the gas, I mean. It's one thing for me to sit up here and say, but it's another thing for us to go out there and do it.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the final play of Game 4
quotes.excerpt: I fell on the floor, I couldn't really see. I don't know. I just saw a block.
quotes.quote: I fell on the floor, I couldn't really see. I don't know. I just saw a block.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on his mindset after the loss
quotes.excerpt: I think it's going to go one of two ways. One of two ways.
quotes.quote: I think it's going to go one of two ways. One of two ways, and a bad one and a good one, and I know the bad one would be giving up, the good one would be getting stronger through this, getting more together, and I know this is what we're going to do.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the Spurs' emotional state after Game 4
quotes.excerpt: It feels like we missing, we worked too hard and give up our leads.
quotes.quote: It was painful. Of course, it feels like we missing, we worked too hard and give up our leads, you know, just it's simple as that. It's just it just hurts.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on how to process the Game 4 loss
quotes.excerpt: I think there's no mode of employment. I don't know if it's got to be digested.
quotes.quote: I think there's no mode of employment. I don't know if it's got to be digested, I think it's got to be feel the pain, the disgust, and I think that it's not something that's learned in fact. Either we have what it takes, or we don't.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the Spurs' second-half offensive struggles
quotes.excerpt: Stop moving the ball, stop executing.
quotes.quote: Stop moving the ball, stop executing.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the potential suspension for the flagrant foul
quotes.excerpt: Of course I'm going to be more, I mean I'm going to be more careful.
quotes.quote: Of course I'm going to be more, I mean I'm going to be more careful, but it's not going to change much.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the Spurs' path forward in the series
quotes.excerpt: Holding each other accountable, communicating, not pointing fingers.
quotes.quote: Holding each other accountable, communicating, not pointing fingers. And after that, we either got it or we don't. But, you know, we've proven that we can surpass these difficulties, and even though we haven't been there before, I'm convinced we're built this way, and we're going to use the better of this and it's going to tighten us up.
